reviews.title: Mighty Mouse
reviews.comment: My favorite mouse, albeit a bit pricey.  Smooth movement, precise responsiveness, and ergonomically pleasing.
reviews.author: shopper

reviews.title: This was a game changer!
reviews.comment: I was personally introduced to this mouse style recently, and I love it! It does take some getting used to, but it feels much better at the end of the day. This mouse specifically has been holding up well. It's very reactive, and the build quality is great. If you want to try this ergonomic style, I would definitely recommend giving this a try.
reviews.author: Steven Feivelson

reviews.title: Great Mouse
reviews.comment: Great Mouse.  Comfortable to use and has a good battery life.  This will be my go-to mouse from now on.
